themes.label: Modern rules reconciling AI with ethics
themes.definition: Call for states to build modern common rules reconciling AI development with ethical rules as part of digital transformation.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for joint international rule-building on AI grounded in ethics.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages mentioning digital transformation without AI rules.
themes.boundary_cases: The ethics component may also warrant AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS.

examples.quote: build modern rules that will allow us to reconcile the development of artificial intelligence with our ethical rules

value.rationale: A single French 2018 passage calling for common modern rules to reconcile AI development with ethics within the wider digital transformation.
